title: cyclosorus bewaniensis
intro: Cyclosorus bewaniensis, commonly known as the Bewani Cyclosorus or Bewani fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that is native to New Guinea and is prized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cyclosorus bewaniensis include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
